description: Creates a new keyword with an existing keyword's settings. Give the new term, or the same term with another groupId, since a group tracks a term once. It copies the kind, platforms, context, every matching rule, the monthly mention cap and the comments setting. Review pages and feeds are copied only when listed in include (reviewSources, feeds), because two keywords on one page collect and bill every review twice. The copy is a new keyword: $5 a month, and its last 30 days come in at once.

groupId.description: The copy's group (grp_...). Omitted, it joins the original's group.

include.description: Also copy these: reviewSources (its review pages) and feeds (its RSS or Atom feeds). Off by default, because two keywords on one page or feed collect, and bill, every review or item twice.

term.description: The copy's term. The original's term is allowed only in another group (groupId), since a group tracks a term once.

name: duplicate_keyword
title: Duplicate keyword
